blocks.html: Element covers all your messaging needs — text, voice messages, calls and video. Here is what you can do once you are signed in.

slides.title: Messaging in Element
slides.html: Element supports text messages, voice messages, voice and video calls, and video conferences. These work in any room or direct message conversation.

slides.title: Space and rooms
slides.html: You automatically join this server's Space as a member. The Space includes all server members and has pre-created rooms, so you can start communicating right away.

slides.title: Messaging in rooms
slides.html: Send messages in any room or start a direct message with other members. You can also create new rooms that are either discoverable by all Space members or join-by-invitation only.

slides.title: Voice and video calls
slides.html: Start a voice or video call directly from any room or direct message — convenient for quick conversations without setting up a meeting.

slides.title: Group video call
slides.html: Element supports high-quality group video calls in rooms — fully equivalent to Microsoft Teams, Skype, or other similar services.

slides.title: Encryption
slides.html: A key feature of Matrix is strong end-to-end encryption: outsiders — including the server itself — cannot access your private messages or group messages.
